phrases.text: By the heaven and the nightly star
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His word, exalted is He: وَالسَّمَاءِ وَالطَّارِقِ ("By the heaven and the night-comer") (1)

phrases.text: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is
˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness
There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺
phrases.ar: إِنْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ

phrases.text: Let people then consider what they were created from
˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid
stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage
Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺
on the Day all secrets will be disclosed
Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper
phrases.ar: فَمَا لَهُ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَلا نَاصِرٍ

phrases.text: By the sky with its recurring cycles
and the earth with its sprouting plants
Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word
and is not to be taken lightly
So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺.
Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while
